title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
slides: Can OpenAI finally outmaneuver Anthropic for enterprise deals?

For your next vendor bid, OpenAI's pricing just became more persuasive.

thread_text:

While Anthropic touts safety, OpenAI's API traffic from Fortune 500s just jumped 30% this quarter.

OpenAI's new per-token rates undercut Anthropic by 20% on high-volume workloads, shifting the ROI math.
